instruction: How many months of spotify premium subscription do I still have left? Round to the nearest number.
notes: Pure information-retrieval task: no database changes are allowed, so all actions are read-only lookups. The agent reads the premium subscription history, identifies the active (not yet expired) subscription, computes the remaining duration from its end_date relative to the given current datetime, rounds to the nearest whole number of months, and passes that value as the answer to supervisor.complete_task. The reference solution lists 5 API calls; the extra call is likely an auxiliary lookup (e.g. a paginated second call or spotify.show_premium_plans) that does not change the plan structure, so the model keeps the minimal 4-step sequence.
